purpose: identify, without performing, the next bounded action for the unresolved duplicate identity that now stands as the remaining Gate 5.1 prerequisite
not_performed: This order identifies the action and stops. No source was retrieved, no identity was adjudicated, no cluster was collapsed, merged or re-classed, and no count was certified.

bounded_action.working_title: PHASE5-001N - Resolve the six identity-unresolved duplicate clusters
bounded_action.objective: decide, for each of the six clusters and for each member row, whether the rows record one legal provision and version or distinct provisions, so that the unique-legal-provision count required by Phase 5.1 bullet 3 can be finalised
scope_in: the six clusters and their fifteen member rows only
the twenty-five IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED relations recorded for those rows in SOURCE_CAPTURES/PHASE5-001L/duplicate_relations.json
for each cluster, the recorded descriptors already present in the 001K and 001L artifacts
scope_out: the other twenty-two rows in the ten demonstrably identical clusters (identity is already determined there)
the two thousand three hundred and seventeen relations already determined distinct as recorded
every disposition, jurisdiction, legal-test or candidate question
the six B20 mapping IDs, whose pending exact report-field/event mapping is a separate Phase 5.2 or 5.3 task
any count certification beyond the unique-provision count for these fifteen rows
two_permitted_routes: an owner ruling on identity for each cluster, stated against the recorded descriptors and quoted back verbatim in the record; or
retrieval of the recorded source artifact for each member row, sufficient to compare instrument, provision descriptor, locator, jurisdiction reference and effective-information keys at first hand
acceptance_criteria: each of the six clusters carries one recorded determination per relation, either IDENTICAL_PROVISION_AND_VERSION or DISTINCT_PROVISION_OR_VERSION, or an explicit residual IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED with the exact missing field named
every one of the fifteen rows keeps its recorded disposition and remains in the catalogue
no row is deleted, collapsed, merged or re-classed by the identity determination alone
the resulting unique-legal-provision count is stated with its evidence, its meaning and any residual limitation, and is not published as a certified corpus or coverage count
removal_permitted stays NO unless and until the owner separately authorises a catalogue change, which would itself be an amendment under Core Constitution section 6
stop_conditions: a returned source contradicts a recorded catalogue field, so the contradiction must be reported rather than resolved by preference
a cluster turns out to require a legal interpretation rather than a source comparison
the retrieval route is unavailable for a member row, in which case that row stays explicitly IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and is queued, and does not block the other five clusters
bounded_action.what_it_would_unblock: the duplicate-identity half of Gate 5.1 and the finalisation of the separately required unique-legal-provision count, and nothing else
what_it_would_not_do: it would not pass Gate 5.1 by itself: passage is a separate determination made against the gate text
it would not admit a rule, create coverage or authorise a finding
it would not certify the B20 aggregate, 425 or 416
it would not begin Gate 5.2 or Phase 5.3
